tools.name: List missions

tools.name: List memories

tools.name: Read a file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from this machine, bounded. Reports the absolute path and byte length; a truncated read says so.

path.description: File to read; a relative path is resolved against the Core's working directory.

maxBytes.description: Bound on the returned content; the tail is reported as truncated, never silently dropped.

tools.name: List a directory
tools.description: List the entries of a directory on this machine (non-recursive), bounded.

path.description: Directory to list; a relative path is resolved against the Core's working directory.

tools.name: Write a file
tools.description: Write a UTF-8 text file on this machine, creating parent directories on request. A WRITE, so the default policy parks it for a human.

path.description: File to write; a relative path is resolved against the Core's working directory.

content.description: The full UTF-8 content of the file.

tools.name: git status
tools.description: Read the working-tree status of a git repository (porcelain). Read-only.

cwd.description: Repository directory; defaults to the Core's working directory.

tools.name: git log
tools.description: Read the recent commit log of a git repository. Read-only.

cwd.description: Repository directory; defaults to the Core's working directory.

tools.name: git diff
tools.description: Read a git diff (working tree, or staged with staged:true). Read-only.

cwd.description: Repository directory; defaults to the Core's working directory.

staged.description: Diff the staged changes instead of the working tree.

tools.name: Run a program
tools.description: Run a program with an explicit argument list (no shell), bounded by timeout and output size. DESTRUCTIVE, so the default policy parks it for a human.

command.description: The program to run (an executable name or path; no shell interpolation).

args.description: Argument list of strings passed to the program.

cwd.description: Working directory; defaults to the Core's working directory.

tools.name: Search KAI's conversations
tools.description: Search KAI's own conversation sessions by id, title and recorded turn text. The query is matched literally (LIKE wildcards are escaped), so searching for "100%" finds the literal percent sign instead of every session.

query.description: The text to find; matched literally in session ids, titles and turn text.

tools.name: Duplicate a conversation session
tools.description: Fork one of KAI's conversation sessions: same title/ownership/binding and the same recorded turns, but deliberately NO worker conversation id — the copy starts its OWN worker conversation on its first turn, which is what keeps per-session worker isolation.

tools.name: Close a conversation session
tools.description: Close (archive) one of KAI's conversation sessions and move the active pointer off it, so KAI is never left writing into a closed conversation. The turns remain recorded; restore re-opens it.

tools.name: Clear a conversation's recorded turns
tools.description: Remove every recorded turn of a session and reset its counters. The session itself survives; the removal cannot be undone.

id.description: The session whose turns are removed.

tools.name: Delete a conversation session
tools.description: Hard-delete a session and every turn recorded in it. The deletion cannot be undone.

note: Declared facts only: `permission.sideEffecting` is derived from the tool's EFFECT (risk !== READ || effectful), and a tool that declares no schema reports `declared: false` with the reason rather than an invented shape. Running a tool is POST /tools/:id/invoke, which goes through the ONE boundary (validate -> policy -> (approval) -> execute).
